caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, narrow neck, and a handle attached from the neck to the body. The jug is shaded in gray tones with a darker shadow at its base to suggest volume and light. On the upper front of the jug, there is an inscription in dark blue capital letters that reads “3 PETERMANN PALATKA, FLA.” Slightly below and to the right of the inscription, a stylized blue floral design with leaves and a blossom is painted on the jug’s surface. There is a lighter oval spot on the lower left side of the jug, possibly representing a reflective highlight or a chip. The background of the drawing is plain, and there is a faint rectangular border around the jug. The artist's signature, “Annie B. Johnston,” is written in small, neat script at the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
